items.title: harness Gitspace hardcoded password for every user account
items.one_liner: Harness Gitspaces ships with a hardcoded default container password that overrides any user-configured secrets.
items.summary: A security vulnerability was discovered in Harness Gitspaces where the password resolver function discards user-configured secret references and instead returns a hardcoded default constant, 'Harness@123', for every container instance. This static password is used to configure the internal Linux account inside every Gitspace container, rendering custom secret configurations ineffective. Because the source code is public, anyone can determine the constant and authenticate directly to any Gitspace instance via published ports. The flaw compromises the isolation and access control of hosted development environments.
items.bottom_line: Hardcoded secrets in container orchestration templates can completely break instance-level isolation and authentication in hosted developer environments.
